outline.rationale: The user is a total ML beginner whose end goal is reading papers, so the outline builds foundations bottom-up before reaching the architecture and the target paper. Nodes 1-3 cover the neural network prerequisites the user explicitly lacks (network structure, the specific math notation papers use, and learning via gradient descent/backprop) since the confirmed understanding said to build these up rather than skip. Nodes 4-7 are the core Transformer machinery (embeddings/positional encoding, self-attention mechanics, multi-head attention, full architecture) prioritized for depth per the user's request. Node 8 explicitly bridges to the paper-reading goal, mapping learned concepts to actual notation. Hands-on coding and training practicalities are excluded per the deprioritization. The math node is separated from the learning node to keep them MECE: one is static notation, the other is the dynamic training process.
